title: Female hijama therapist in South London: privacy and booking
summary: Women can review a female practitioner, privacy arrangements, and two exact South London appointment choices before booking.
html:
Women seeking hijama in South London benefit from privacy-centred choices at Sincerity Cupping Clinic.

The short answer

Women can book with Sister Aisha Mejri, enjoying private sessions at 330 Streatham High Rd SW16 6HH. Open daily 10:00-19:00, sessions run 60-75 minutes using single-use sterile equipment from £45.

Who is the female practitioner?

Sister Aisha Mejri provides women-only hijama appointments with a guarantee of privacy and professional care backed by over 20+ years of experience.

What should women know about their appointments?

The clinic ensures clarity at every stage. Booking confirms selections through Fresha. Practitioners always provide opportunities to ask questions pre-session.

What are the service options?

  • Women’s wet cupping: £45 for 45 minutes
  • Women’s full spiritual appointment: £80 for 90 minutes

Is it suitable if pregnant or on medication?

Cupping is complementary care. Women who are pregnant, diabetic, or on blood-thinners should seek specific advice before booking to ensure safety.
